title: Tennet language
description: Eastern Sudanic language spoken by the Tennet people of South Sudan
extract: Tennet is a Surmic language spoken by the Tennet people in South Sudan. The Tennet home area is a group of fifteen (15) villages at the northern part of Eastern Equatoria state, 65 kilometers northeast of Torit.
